verdict.rationale: Turso's local-development docs recommend a local database file that runs entirely in your process with no server needed. Its introduction describes an embedded engine that works offline, and there is also a local libSQL server option, an open-source libSQL fork (MIT) and a standalone `tursodb` shell. One community user confirms running it locally as well as on the hosted service. missing for 10: an explicit statement that no account or API key is needed for local use, documentation of CI test workflows, and an explicit guarantee that the local engine matches the cloud engine.
